items.title: Fortive (FTV) Released A No Code Platform For Calibration Labs
items.summary: Fortive (NYSE:FTV) subsidiary Fluke has launched CalStudio Conduit, a no-code workflow and integration platform for calibration laboratories. The new tool is designed to automate calibration lab workflows and connect existing systems without custom coding. CalStudio Conduit targets improved data handling and integration across lab equipment, software and quality systems.
